data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Welsh word 'frid', meaning 'peace, freedom'. In Christian context, Fryd represents the joy and freedom found in the love of God. The name Fryd carries the meaning “Joyful, Free” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fryd usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
